a single nucleotide deletion was identified within the C/ EBP-like site of the TP53 promoter and was found in two of eighteen LFS and L FL families without detectable coding region TP53 mutations, compared to only one in 366 control samples, suggesting that this variant may be a rare polymorphism that arose within the TP53 promotor.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
this variant is a rare, non-functional polymorphism that is not responsible for LFS or LFL.
this variant does not have a role in the pathogenesis of Li-Fraumemi Syndrome.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we identified an identical single-nucleotide deletion within the TP53 tumor-suppressor promoter in 11% of LFS/LFL families without a coding-region mutation, compared to only 1/366 controls.
